svg.title: watsonx.data integration in three of IBM’s figures
svg.desc: Three of IBM's figures for watsonx.data integration: four kinds of data in one product, batch, streaming, replication and unstructured; anomalies detected from metadata in near real time; a free 30-day trial to explore the full set of capabilities. Each figure is IBM's, from its watsonx.data integration, pricing and data observability pages. IBM states no test conditions for them.
